age.evidence: we evaluated offspring at P90 on prepulse inhibition of acoustic startle (PPI) and open-field behavior

sex.evidence: Unless stated, experiments used equal numbers of males and females.

dosing.evidence: Timed-pregnant dams received subcutaneous injections in sterile 0.9% saline: ... (+)-lysergic acid diethylamide tartrate (LSD) 0.3 mg kg⁻¹ ... Pregnant mice received either one single LSD injection at E12.5 (acute) or daily injections from E12.5 to E16.5 (repeated)

assays.assay_description: Adult offspring (P90) explored a 40×40 cm arena for 15 min. Primary outcomes: total distance traveled and rotational stereotypy; spatial occupancy heatmaps as descriptive visualizations.

application_type.evidence: Timed-pregnant dams received subcutaneous injections ... LSD 0.3 mg kg⁻¹

setup_restrain.evidence: Adult CD-1 mice... explored a 40×40 cm arena for 15 min

food_restriction.evidence: Animals tested in 40×40 cm arena (no food in apparatus)

water_restriction.evidence: Animals tested in 40×40 cm arena (no water in apparatus)

time_to_assay.evidence: offspring at P90 ... maternal injections at E12.5 to E16.5

sample_size.evidence: Adult CD-1 mice (n=10 per condition unless noted)

outcomes.summary: Prenatal LSD exposure increased rotational stereotypy in adult offspring (acute: 136.2±31.3; repeated: 81.4±18.8; control: 54.2±12.6 rotations) without large changes in total distance or velocity. 'High-rotators' were more frequent in LSD groups.
outcomes.statistics: Group LR χ²=8.02, P=0.018; Tukey control vs acute P=0.013
outcomes.evidence: Total rotations were increased following prenatal LSD (negative-binomial GLM, Group LR χ²=8.02, P=0.018; back-transformed means ±SE: control 54.2 ±12.6, acute 136.2 ±31.3, repeated 81.4 ±18.8; Tukey control vs acute P=0.013).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Data reported as total distance and total rotations over the 15-min session

B8_multivariate.evidence: Analyses reported as separate univariate tests

E3_bedding.evidence: Standard open field with no bedding described

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in arena

D1_continuity.evidence: explored a 40×40 cm arena for 15 min

D2_session_duration.evidence: explored a 40×40 cm arena for 15 min

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline recorded in offspring

D5_followup.evidence: offspring evaluated at P90, well over 24h after last prenatal dose

assays.assay_description: Acoustic startle chamber: background 60 dB, prepulses 70/74/78/82 dB (20 ms), startle 105 dB (40 ms), 100 ms ISI, 10-30 s ITI. Measures %PPI, startle amplitude, startle latency.

application_type.evidence: Timed-pregnant dams received subcutaneous injections ... LSD 0.3 mg kg⁻¹

setup_restrain.evidence: PPI startle chambers (typically use body-restraint holders)

food_restriction.evidence: Standard PPI session, no food in chamber

water_restriction.evidence: Standard PPI session, no water in chamber

time_to_assay.evidence: evaluated offspring at P90 on prepulse inhibition; maternal injections at E12.5 to E16.5

sample_size.evidence: Adult CD-1 mice (n=10 per condition unless noted)

outcomes.summary: Prenatal LSD exposure reduced PPI in adult offspring, with the most robust reduction in males after repeated exposure. Startle amplitude was higher in females in both LSD conditions; startle latency was largely unchanged.
outcomes.evidence: When sexes were combined, PPI was reduced after prenatal LSD ... males showed reduced PPI following repeated exposure, whereas females did not differ at the group level

B1_num_measures.evidence: %PPI, startle amplitude, and startle latency reported

B4_ethological.evidence: PPI startle magnitude is not ethological

B5_social.evidence: Animal tested alone in startle chamber

E3_bedding.evidence: Startle chamber has solid floor, no bedding

D1_continuity.evidence: PPI measured in a single session

D5_followup.evidence: P90 testing follows prenatal maternal exposure (E12.5-E16.5)

judge_notes: Only two behavioural assays in offspring were scored: Open Field Test and Prepulse Inhibition. Pharmacokinetic LC-MS/MS measurements, Fos qPCR/IHC in choroid plexus, light-sheet imaging, cortical marker quantification, and body/brain weight measurements are not behavioural assays and were excluded.
D5 (post-acute follow-up) scored Yes for both assays because adult offspring testing at P90 occurs >24h after the last prenatal maternal dose (overriding gptoss which scored 0).
B1 scored 1 (2-3 measures) for OFT: total distance + rotational stereotypy; for PPI: %PPI + startle amplitude + startle latency.
Setup_restrain for PPI scored 'yes' since standard startle chambers use body-restraint tubes, per rubric examples; confidence medium since not explicitly stated.
Dosing schedule marked 'multiple' because both acute (single dose) and repeated (5 doses over 5 days) regimens were used in the same assay.
